calibration_anchor.closest_anchor: Incremental product launch wrapped in AI thought-leadership buzzword
calibration_anchor.why_not_higher: 'The future of human-AI collaboration is here' is a generic buzzword claim with no proof; 466 upvotes is a community-vote metric, not news
calibration_anchor.why_not_lower: There is a real shipped product and a coherent AI/enterprise beat, so it is not the absolute floor

beat_relevance.rationale: AI/enterprise software is a real beat, but reporters do not cover Product Hunt placements

timeliness.rationale: Only timing is a self-generated launch-day ranking; no external moment

magnitude.rationale: Seed unknown startup; no users, revenue, or customer scale stated

proof_points.rationale: data_available is false; upvotes and 'agents work together seamlessly' are not proof

narrative_quality.rationale: Buzzword framing ('future is here') with no conflict, surprise, or concrete before/after

source_credibility.rationale: Unknown seed startup, no independent credentials

improvement_suggestions: Drop the 'future of human-AI collaboration' buzzword; AI being a hot category is not a story
Bring first-party data: teams using it, measured handoff time saved, retention, named customer
Tie to a concrete, current workflow problem a specific reporter is covering

evidence_used.title: Vokal trended top 3 on Product Hunt with 466 upvotes

evidence_gaps: Usage or efficiency data with methodology
Any external news hook beyond the launch
honest_assessment: AI agents being a hot category is not a story and there is no proof, no data, and no hook here, just a Product Hunt ranking and a buzzword. The generic 'future is here' framing is marketing, not news. Hold.

next_move.rationale: Hold until there is original data and a real external hook
